chief_complaint: Recent acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (chest pain) with ongoing cardiovascular management and newly diagnosed metastatic prostate cancer.
history_of_present_illness: The patient suffered an acute STEMI on 2024-03-09, was treated emergently and has remained on dual antiplatelet therapy, beta‑blocker, high‑intensity statin and antihypertensives. Blood pressure remains stage 2 despite a three‑drug regimen, and heart rate is mildly elevated. In October 2024 metastatic prostate cancer was diagnosed; the record references leuprolide and docetaxel but these agents are not listed in the current medication list. He has longstanding major depressive disorder, daily tobacco use, obesity, prediabetes, anemia, and chronic sinusitis. Socially, he reports isolation, limited contact, and significant transportation barriers, which have limited outpatient follow‑up (0 outpatient visits recorded).
